exchanges: hiii
Hey! What's up?
nothin just moved to saskatoon w my mom. dont know anyone
That's a big change. How long have you been there?
like 4 days. school starts tmrw
Starting so soon is rough, but it means you'll meet people faster.
ya i guess. im scared ngl
Totally normal. Most people feel that way on a first day somewhere new.
my dog biscuit is the only one who gets me rn lol
Dogs are great for that. What kind is she?
corgi mix. shes so dramatic
Corgis are famously dramatic, she's living up to it.
ok first day done
You made it! How'd it go?
kinda ok?? got put w a lab partner for chem, his name is jordan
A lab partner is a built-in person to talk to. Is he nice?
ya hes chill. he rides a motorbike to school which is lowkey cool
That's a pretty memorable first impression.
also funny bc my moms bf is ALSO named jordan
Ha, that's going to make dinner conversations confusing.
fr. he came over to help unpack, he drove his minivan full of our stuff from regina
That's a lot of help, the move must have been way easier with him.
ya hes ok i guess
Sounds like he's trying, at least.
met a girl at lunch, seun. shes on the basketball team
Nice, someone to sit with at lunch is a big deal in the first week.
shes rly funny. her full name is oluwaseun but evry1 says seun
Good to know. Sounds like you two clicked.
i have to get braces ugh. appt w the orthodontist friday
Braces are annoying at first but you get used to them fast.
his name is dr pham. moms making me go
Moms usually win that one. At least you'll be done before graduation.
also we have to sign up w a family dr here, mom found one, dr rahimi
Getting a family doctor sorted early is a good move.
wait i was wrong seun isnt on basketball its volleyball. i mixed it up bc they practice in the same gym
Easy mix-up if they share a gym. Are you thinking of trying out?
idk im short lol
Height helps, but plenty of good players are short, especially in back row positions.
jordan from chem keeps bugging me to join chess club
He must like having you around. Could be worth trying once.
mayb. biscuit dug a hole under the fence today and got out
Oh no, did you find her okay?
ya she was at the neighbours eating their cat food
Dramatic and a thief. At least she didn't go far.
the neighbour lady was nice abt it. shes old and has like 3 cats
Good that she was understanding. A board along the fence might stop the digging.
mom said shell fix it on the weekend
Hopefully that ends the cat food buffet.
lol. braces are on now. everything hurts
The first few days are the worst. Soft food and cold drinks help.
i joined robotics club today tho!! we're building a thing that picks up cans
That's awesome, it's a great way to meet people who like building stuff.
the teacher who runs it is mr achebe hes super into it
An excited teacher makes clubs way more fun.
we have a competition in feb
That gives you a goal to work toward with the team.
